# Learnings

* [Presentation changes must not change logic](logic-preservation.md) - UI refactors are strictly visual; mixing logic and design changes hides regressions.
* [One tenant key drives all access control](one-tenant-key.md) - Mixed per-user and per-organization checks caused silent data-access failures.
* [Inspect the schema before writing queries](schema-first.md) - Agents that guess column names produce plausible, wrong code; read the real schema first.
